task:
The user notes: "when I am using inspector in browser, i see @theme has all of the standard tailwind colors etc while my index css has its own @theme assets."

They are using Tailwind v4. We want to only use their custom `@theme` variables defined in `src/index.css` and disable/remove the default Tailwind theme colors/variables so it's not bloating the CSS output and devtools.

Investigate how to disable the default theme in Tailwind v4 (e.g., using `@import "tailwindcss/theme" layer(theme);` or `@theme reference { ... }` or similar concepts in v4, or maybe setting `source(none)` or clearing the default theme). 
If needed, update `src/index.css` so that only the custom theme variables are available and the default Tailwind colors are removed.
Explain the fix to the user via attempt_completion.
